literal: Lack of knowledge is the poverty among poverties; other lack, as poverty, the world will not consider.
translation: The lack of knowledge is the poorest of all poverties; the world does not consider any other kind of deprivation to be true poverty.
modern: அறிவில்லாமையே வறுமைகளுள் மிகக் கொடிய வறுமையாகும்; மற்ற குறைபாடுகளை உலகம் வறுமையாகக் கருதாது.
explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate form of destitution as the lack of knowledge or wisdom. While people generally view the absence of material wealth as poverty, the author asserts that such material lack is not true poverty. The world does not regard other forms of deprivation as significant because they can be overcome or endured with effort. In contrast, a lack of understanding is a fundamental deficiency that renders a person truly helpless, regardless of what else they might possess.
